verdict.rationale: Users get some control over what data Manufact stores. Payload capture is an opt-in toggle, so full request and response bodies are kept only if enabled (manufact-docs-13). URL-connected servers can also be switched from the Manufact proxy back to a direct connection, taking traffic out of the gateway (manufact-docs-19). Missing for 10: documented retention periods or configurable retention windows, user-initiated deletion of logs/events/payloads, account or server data deletion and export, and any independent corroboration.
